posts.title: WHISTLER by Ann Patchett: Is this me?
posts.description: I just finished Ann Patchett’s Whistler , which I waited nearly 5 months for on Libby. It was a gorgeously written book, still with the dreamy quality that I remember from reading Bel Canto , the last Patchett I read, over a decade ago. It engrossed me, and I think I truly liked it. posts.title: Disappearances
posts.description: I suddenly missed this blog. But life has been life-ing, and work has been work-ing, and I accept that I have my ebbs and flows. (Probably why I can no longer sustain a community, except for the one community that I am required and quite happy to be in—my family.)
